about: Every OBP-API call the tokenizer makes, all through internal/obp/client.go: verb, path (OBP placeholders in capitals; ENTITY is one of the entity names in internal/obp/client.go), the source file and the text that makes the call (needles), and the response fields the code reads. scripts/create_test_data.py, which seeds test data, is not listed. internal/obp/contract_test.go checks this list against the source and against snapshot.json, which obp-api-contract/snapshot.py writes from an OBP-API's resource docs.

calls.undocumented_endpoint: the unversioned DirectLogin route has no resource doc; OBP-API documents DirectLogin as POST /obp/v6.0.0/my/logins/direct (OBPv6.0.0-directLoginEndpoint, also listed under v7.0.0, answering token), but the snapshot cannot show that both reach the same implementation, so the call is left as it is

calls.note: Filtered by status_code, parcel_id or activity_id. Each record is decoded into its type in internal/obp/types.go.
calls.undocumented_endpoint: dynamic entity, defined at run time

calls.note: The record under the entity name is decoded into its type in internal/obp/types.go, and the raw body is hashed (keccak256) into the token's integrity hash. The same URL is stored on-chain as the record's link.
